selection_reasoning: The task 'find yellow_concrete' is a straightforward navigation/observation task that requires the agent to locate a yellow concrete block placed in the scene. It is easily verifiable (the agent must look at or be near the block), does not require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge, and is observable in the game environment. As a single atomic task, no dependency edges are needed.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the yellow concrete structure (center at spawn-relative 6,1,4) and face toward it. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk toward the target (spawn is ~7.3 blocks away, so turning alone won't trigger it). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the yellow concrete, confirming visual identification.

scene_description: An open grassy area with a prominent 3x3x3 yellow concrete structure placed ~5-7 blocks from spawn at positive X/Z. A stone brick structure sits at negative X/Z, a cobblestone wall at positive X / negative Z, a barrel at Z+6, and a decorative lantern on a fence post near the yellow concrete. The scene provides visual variety while making the yellow concrete clearly findable.
task_text: Find the yellow concrete blocks in the scene. Look around and walk toward them.
design_notes: Yellow concrete is a 3x3x3 structure at ~5,0,3 to ~7,2,5 — center at (6,1,4), approximately 7.3 blocks from spawn. The grass platform ensures flat terrain. Air fill clears any natural obstacles in the immediate area. Stone bricks and cobblestone wall serve as visual distractors. The lantern on a fence post is a landmark near the target. max_distance=5 was chosen (reduced from initial 16) to ensure the player must actually navigate toward the target rather than just turning from spawn.
